items.lang|tensura_blade|tensura_blade.sword_s:
[Toggle Passive] Blessing of the Sword Saint
Unlocked. Sword melee and sweeping strikes deal void damage, bypassing dodge, resistance, nullification and barriers. Creative, invulnerability and PvP protections remain. Requires the Bearer passive toggle; sheathed dragon swords do not trigger it. Grants one Dragon Sword on unlock.
Dragon Sword removes 0.5 maximum health per point of actual health damage from non-player enemies until death, with a minimum maximum health of 1. When no recognized enemy remains within 16 blocks, returns to its sheath after 10 seconds, including after a kill or leaving detection range. Reentry cancels the countdown; leaving again starts a new 10-second countdown.
